name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: Panels separated by handles you drag or move with the keyboard.
a11y: Each handle is a focusable role="separator" with aria-orientation, aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-controls pointing at the panel it resizes.
Arrow keys resize by the step (horizontal groups use Left/Right, vertical groups Up/Down; mirrored in right-to-left); PageUp/PageDown resize by double; Home and End jump to the limits.
minSize and maxSize are enforced for both keyboard and pointer, and are reflected in aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax.
Handles are at least 24 CSS px to grab and show the focus ring.
